**sdd/issue-231-a2/design**

A2 (#231) design. D1 include:local opt-in — ship brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml as managed literal; consumer root .gitlab-ci.yml LOCAL; adoption = one `include: local:` line, unverifiable by brain (honest residual F1 inherits). Rejected: root .gitlab-ci.yml (clobbers consumer's single pipeline file) and installer YAML-merge (no zero-dep writer). D2 THE GOTCHA (scope-shaping): GitLab lacks CI_MERGE_REQUEST_DESCRIPTION + labels freeze at pipeline creation, so issue-link/diff-size cannot be bash; extend run-check.mjs (today memory-gate+decision-gate) with issue-link case = issueLink(ctx.body)+approved-label verify via injectable issue-fetch, diff-size case = diffSize(numstat, ignoreList) with size:exception from FRESH ctx.labels; all 8 GitLab jobs run node run-check.mjs <job>; pure evaluators UNCHANGED; A2 is NOT just a YAML. D3 exit mapping: REQUIRED normal (block), DETECTION allow_failure:true (Amendment 3), never flatten. D4 governance.approvedLabel additive config-migrations entry + resolveApprovedLabel(config,provider) → status:approved GitHub / status::approved GitLab; replaces 3 hardcoded reads; GitHub issue-link bash sources label from tiny node CLI (no bash config-parser); TOUCHES brain/core/config-migrations.mjs → L6 brain-writes-reviewed gate (4th slice to touch, PASS+warn). D5 drift-guard string-slices both YAMLs. Files: create gitlab-governance.yml, approved-label.mjs; modify run-check.mjs, config-migrations.mjs, actor-check.mjs, brain-start.mjs, governance.yml, managed-paths.mjs, ci-context-drift-guard.test.mjs. OPEN Q: migration version — reuse C4-freed 0.6.0 (recommend) vs 0.7.0; reconcile vs sibling C4 landing order on feature/v2.0.0. CP-A2a fixture-tested acceptance; CP-A2b live e2e deferred. Full artifact openspec/changes/issue-231-a2/design.md + ADR draft openspec/changes/issue-231-a2/brain-drafts/adr-0018-gitlab-governance-pipeline.md.
